bounded_model.formula: q_new=sigmoid(logit(clip(q,1e-6,1-1e-6))*sum_j(hat_j(u)*s_j)), anchors at0,.5,1, all s_j in[-1,1]. One fixed middle knot, not selected by quantiles, months or past best-return statebins.
bounded_model.basis: z=2u-1; hat=(max(-z,0),1-abs(z),max(z,0)). Nonnegative weights sum1, continuous piecewise-linear reliability. q=.5 staysneutral; abslogodds cannot amplify.
bounded_model.penalty: .5*(a-1)^2+.5*b^2+.5*c^2 where a=(s0+s2)/2,b=(s2-s0)/2,c=s1-a. Matrix T.T*T positive definite; prior all1. Setting c=0 recovers BOTH v52 linear prediction and penalty exactly. No silent penalty reduction from adding middleanchor.
bounded_model.objective: Binarylogloss(I(D>0)), timeweights*abs(D), normalizeNdates. Zero directionmass preserves exact q. Learned before60dates preservesourceq. C/M unchanged.
bounded_model.solver: 3D box Newton quadratic uses all27faces, positive-definite fullpenaltymatrix, Armijo50max,100stepsmax; optimizationtol1e-10*Ndates, finalprojectedgradient<=1e-8*Ndates. Linear/global delegate frozenv52 fitters, all old solvermetadata preserved.

state_definition.formula: u=(1+(tanh(relative_5)+breadth_5+volume_direction_diffusion)/3)/2, bounded[0,1]. Fixed equal component weights; no fitted thresholds or standardization.
